title: Rates of Decay for $(α, β)$-Ritt-Kreiss Operators
summary: This paper investigates the growth of the sequences $(\|T^n(I-T)^k\|)_{n\ge 1}$ for bounded linear operators on Banach spaces under various resolvent conditions. Focusing on $α$-Ritt operators that are also strongly Kreiss bounded, we show that the growth estimates established by Nevanlinna for Kreiss bounded operators can be significantly refined within the Hilbert space setting, nearly attaining the optimal rates obtained by Seifert for the more restrictive power-bounded case.
